summary: The article provides a generally reliable overview of Adani Enterprises' business model, valuations, and future prospects, with most claims being verifiable against recent financial reports and news articles.

claims.claim: In FY 2024-25, the company's incubated businesses reportedly contributed a substantial 60% to its total EBITDA, highlighting their growing importance as primary performance drivers.
claims.note: Groww and Adani Enterprises' own FY25 results announcement confirm that incubating businesses contributed 60% of total EBITDA in FY 2024-25.

claims.claim: Adani Enterprises is currently trading at a Price-to-Earnings (P/E) ratio between approximately 38.05x and 58.16x.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the P/E ratio for Adani Enterprises falls within this range as of August 2026.

claims.claim: For instance, in February 2023, valuation guru Aswath Damodaran assessed Adani Enterprises' fair value at around ₹945 per share, even with optimistic assumptions on revenue growth and operating margins, a figure significantly below its then-market price.
claims.note: Several news articles from February 2023 report Aswath Damodaran's assessment of Adani Enterprises' fair value at approximately ₹945 per share.

claims.claim: foreign holdings in Adani Enterprises had sunk to a record low in June 2026
claims.note: A Business Standard article from August 2026 and a Livemint article from July 2026 confirm that foreign holdings in Adani Enterprises reached a record low in June 2026.

claims.claim: The company's substantial capital expenditure (capex) in these areas, which was reportedly ₹1.5 trillion last year—a third of the entire private sector's capex—underscores its commitment to these growth drivers.
claims.note: Multiple sources from June 2026 confirm Adani's capex of ₹1.5 trillion (or ₹1.53 lakh crore) in FY26, stating it was the highest by any Indian corporate and a significant portion of the private sector's capex.

article_title: Adani Enterprises: Rich valuations and holding-company discount risk may cap gains
